text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …Not agaaain. Ughhh, I've been waking up so early recently.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: That part-time job I've been doing does involve a lot of sitting down… Maybe I'm not getting enough exercise?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: But I should really be getting proper rest. Okay, I'll just go back to sleep…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Scratch that! I want to get out there and run!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems like Ines Fujin is so eager to run that she's waking up early and missing out on sleep…
